claims.text: agent_version returns the SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical inputs containing constitution_sha256, sorted skill pins and memory_gen.
_pins validates each pin has exactly skill_id and sha256, rejects duplicates and returns sorted copies.
_inputs rejects a malformed constitution digest or memory_gen outside 0 through 9007199254740991 with bad_args.

decision.rule: Change here when agent version inputs, skill pin ordering or digest validation needs to change.
decision.failure: Two agents with identical inputs get different versions, or an invalid digest is accepted into the version.

questions.q: Where is the agent version hash computed from constitution, skills and memory generation?
Where should I change skill pin sorting or duplicate rejection before hashing?
Where can I debug a bad_args failure from agent_version validation?
